source_note: Public web search did not find reliable exact chest pages; this catalog uses user-confirmed game item categories plus known Survivor.io item family names. Mark unknown choices as needs_screenshot.

s_grade_choice_pack.optimizer_use: Ask exact current need, then map family and slot. Do not assume it is always chest/belt/boots.

voidwalker_supply_crate.gives: one selectable Voidwaker S-grade equipment item
voidwalker_supply_crate.optimizer_use: Only use for Voidwaker equipment fodder or a Voidwaker item need.

core_choice_chest.optimizer_use: Use for Astral Forge / Cosmic Cast equipment core requirements. It does not give equipment and does not give tech skills.

tech_core_choice_chest.optimizer_use: Use for tech core / Twinborn tech requirements. It does not give Drone, Lightning, Soccer, Laser, Rocket, Molotov directly.

relic_core_chest.optimizer_use: Use for SS gear forge requirements.

possible_uses: Xeno pet awakening or star progress
xeno_pet_crystal.optimizer_use: Ask which Xeno pet has the next breakpoint and spend only if it completes a breakpoint.

awakening_crystal.optimizer_use: Do not spend unless JSON says the target and next breakpoint.

optimizer_rules.output_format: BEFORE / POSSIBLE PICKS / BEST VALID PICK / AFTER
